messages.author: Annika Strøm
messages.text: Runner 3 PM on the 17th is storage-fabric maintenance, not usable. Runner 2 AM on the 16th and PM on the 15th are protected — Marta only.

messages.author: Imogen Vance
messages.text: Six segments of baseline set 8810 cover all four; 8795 is inside the purge horizon (04-23) and not for these.

messages.author: Annika Strøm
messages.text: The runbook lets two patch verifications run back to back in one window.
